marketBrief.headline: Nasdaq falls 1.07% as tech sells off; Dow gains 0.41% and oil drops at the close
marketBrief.summary: At the 4:00 p.m. ET close the S&P 500 lost 0.51% to 7,541.40 and the Nasdaq Composite fell 1.07% to 25,164.32, while the Dow rose 213.67 points to 51,983.98 (CNBC). Brent settled 7.63% lower at $104.77 (CNBC). Palantir reported after the close and fell about 3% in after-hours trading (24/7 Wall St.).
bullets: S&P 500 7,541.40, down 0.51%, at the 4:00 p.m. ET close (CNBC).
Nasdaq Composite 25,164.32, down 1.07%; QQQ down 1.36% (CNBC, StockTitan).
Dow Jones Industrial Average 51,983.98, up 213.67 points or 0.41% (CNBC).
Marvell and Lumentum closed sharply lower after Marvell agreed to buy Lumentum in a deal valued at about $115 billion including debt (CNBC, StockTitan).
Palantir: Q3 revenue up 96%, 2026 guidance raised to 91% growth; shares about 3% lower after hours at $178.46 (Business Wire, 24/7 Wall St.).

calendar.event: Reserve Bank of Australia rate decision
calendar.why: Forecast 4.85% vs 4.60%, a 25-basis-point hike (InvestingLive); guidance matters as much as the move.
All 435 House seats and 35 Senate seats are contested (Trading Economics); the result sets the room for the President's agenda.
Nonfarm payrolls forecast +56,000 and unemployment 4.2% (Trading Economics); a key input for rate-hike expectations.
